newsitem.title: UK: BOC falls as SBC Warburg cuts estimates.
newsitem.headline: BOC falls as SBC Warburg cuts estimates.

text.p: Shares in BOC Group Plc were lower on Wednesday amid concern over the impact of sterling's recent strength on group earnings and as analysts downgraded forecasts. The shares were off 10p at 845p by 1420 GMT.

SBC Warburg cut current year forecasts to 421 million stg from 438 million stg whilst maintaining the stock's "hold" rating. Next year's profit forecasts were shaved to 424 million stg from 442 million stg.
"The downgrade is purely on the impact of a stronger sterling," said a market source.
